description: A green PR carrying a gate:* label with NO declared dependency behind it → UNDECIDABLE. The label projects a status nothing declares (groom-sweep-policy §3.3), so neither branch is derivable: reading it as blocked asserts blocked-ness, reading its absence as clear is the 2026-07-22 incident. Critically, UNDECIDABLE also keeps it out of the auto-merge path — the PR is green, mergeable and carries the groom-reviewed lane label, so a core that resolved the unbacked projection in the permissive direction would merge it.

items.title: Gated PR whose gate is a bare label
